Time Periods can be used with Anchor Date, Anchor Month, Anchor Month Number, and Anchor Week End Date if a user wants to create a specific “as of” or end to the time period. Example: If Last Week is used with an Anchor Week End Date of 6/5/2021 then the Last Week would aggregate sales for 5/30/2021 – 6/5/2021. Anchor Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the date the snapshot was taken. Example: Open Orders Snapshot with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what Open Orders were on 6/7/2021. Non-Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the last date of transactions included in the time period selected. Example: Invoice Sales with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what shipped on or before 6/7/2021 for the time period selected.
Allows the selection of a specific date to view the data “as of” – to be used to with the time period fields.
